name: Pamina Prime
description: Pamina Prime was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was home to shellfish that were responsible of a deadly disease when eaten, the Borotavi syndrome. Jedi Master Taria Damsin was diagnosed with this disease after eating a local blue-shelled mollusk with a green stripe.
